title: pm-dispatch filing gate: drop the three-cards-per-fire quota, file one card per defect (maintainer's direct task, 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ — a task the maintainer assigned directly.
Who acts: the `domain:skills` seat, on a `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` PR. That is a governed-surface PR, so it lands only with the maintainer's authorized approval.
Duplicate search: `pm-dispatch filing gate quota three issues per fire limit` — 18 hits (all closed). None of them is about this quota.

## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread, quoted verbatim)

> skills 需要立一张卡，去掉 只能提交3个issue 的限制。

## Where the limit lives

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md`, section 〈立卡门〉, line 30:

```text
- 配额:一席每 fire 至多三张,超出折清单卡或座位贴;QA/走查逐缺陷立不限张数,守批量间隔。
```

As written, a seat may file **at most three cards per fire**. Anything beyond that is folded into a list card or the seat post. QA and walkthrough runs are already exempt.

## What changes

- Delete the per-fire cap of three cards. A seat may then file one card per defect, as many as it finds, provided each one passes the filing gate (categories ①–④ and the three answers required before POST).
- Keep what the cap sat beside:
  - the four-category gate;
  - the batch write gap (write-pace rule ⑤ and the relay's stroke pacing, see #24755);
  - the triage seat's ten-at-a-time cleanup of existing cards, which is a separate rule (the next bullet in the file).
- Reword the rest of the line so that "fold into a list card" stays available as an option, not a requirement.

## Context the PR should not lose

The line comes from the maintainer ruling quoted at the top of 〈立卡门〉: an account was banned on 2026-09-21 during a triage batch. The point of that ruling was to keep unneeded issues from being filed, and to pace writes. The gate and the write pacing carry that intent. The flat count of three does not: in a release test pass on 2026-10-23 it made findings look like "only 3 problems" when the walkthroughs had found far more.

## Acceptance notes

- `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` stay green. The line ceiling of `filing-gate.md` holds.
- No other file restates the three-card cap. A grep for `至多三张` under `.claude/` returns zero hits after the change.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- 改了什么:删掉 pm-dispatch 立卡门里「一席每 fire 至多三张」的配额，发现几个缺陷就立几张卡。
- 为什么改:维护者 2026-10-23 直派。这个配额让发版测试的发现被压成「只有 3 个问题」。
- 风险与代价(含回滚):立卡四类门和批量写间隔都保留，防刷卡、防封号的保护还在。回滚即还原这一行。
- 你要做的:PR 是受管面，需要你批准后落地。
